svg.aria-label: Scene by scene attribution of Double Falsehood
svg.text: Bars: Fletcher (orange), Shakespeare (blue), Theobald (green), 18th-century (grey). Dots: impostors score for Fletcher (orange) and Shakespeare (blue); dotted line: 0.8 threshold.
Right panel dashed lines: median of Fletcher scenes in Henry VIII and TNK (orange), of Shakespeare scenes (blue) and of 18th-century plays (grey).
